scope: Independent read-only review of newly implemented two-station options and selected actual schedules. No legacy Agent solver imported/executed; no main code changed.

static_review.evidence: MultiProfiles 每个 row 仅写一个 station；联合 solver 每候选恰选一个 option；validator 将 row.station 映射到唯一已排中继任务并整段检查其服务窗。
requirements 按每站所有已分配区段的最早开始与最晚结束建立，solver 分别使该站 active 并约束覆盖；不将两站候选覆盖等同两站同时在岗。
几何递归的左右子段均包含分裂端点；每侧整个闭线段均通过距离上界或 DEM 三角区域净空证明。数据实际换站时刻、坐标及两側 active/access/backhaul 已另行核查。
单站 options 被 deepcopy 后保留，并用 single:station 兼容旧 hint；新42站前缀及21条旧架次 options/rows 已重算相等，详见独立证据文件。

static_review.topic: 验证器没有以采样替代连续证明
static_review.evidence: 每 row 重新以唯一已排站生成整段连续证书。五点采样仅附加诊断。架次站数上限由显式 policy 读取，其余实际任务和连续约束仍保留。

relay_to_relay_switches.endpoint_rule: Intervals left-closed/right-open; final interval includes final endpoint. At switch use right row; both continuous closed-segment proofs cover the endpoint. Direct G01 has priority.

limitations: No global optimality claim; finite station pairs and certificate-induced switching assignments.
All physical energy, box, battery and fleet checks are delegated to the separately saved complete validator reports; this review recomputes communication for every actual multistation sortie.
Geometry primitives are shared with the validator; this is a fresh recomputation and implementation review, not an independently implemented terrain/radio engine.
A pair key alone does not prove two stations were used: actual row station sets decide.
Endpoint link values are diagnostic witnesses accompanying whole-segment certificates, never substitutes for continuous proofs.
